eventSectionBody: On Each Board: During the first Ravage Action, increase the total Damage Invaders deal to the land by the Invader Stage. (Damage to {Dahan} in that land is not increased.)
Remove 1 {Blight} per player from the Blight Card, returning it to the box.
Each Spirit may prevent 1 {Blight} from being Removed by Destroying 2 of their {Presence}.
On Each Board: Isolate a land with {Beast}. 1 {Fear} if Invaders are present.
On Each Board with 5 or more {Dahan}: Add 1 {Dahan} to the land with the most {Dahan}.

1 {Fear} per Power Card in play that generates {Fear}. (In its instructions, not by destroying {Town}/{City}. Count thresholds even if you don't have the Elements. Generated {Fear} can't cause Wavering Resolve.)
Remove 1 Health worth of Invaders per Power Card in play that generates {Fear}.
(In its instructions, not by destroying {Town}/{City}. Count thresholds even if you don't have the Elements.)
On Each Board: 1 Damage in a land with {Badlands}/{Beast}. 1 Damage to {Dahan} in a land with {Badlands}/{Beast} and {Dahan}.
...and 3 or fewer {Dahan}: Also Add 1 {Blight} to a land with {Town}/{City}.
On Each Board with 9 or more {Town}/{City}: Build Cards skip the highest-numbered matching land.
On Each Board with 3 or fewer {Town}/{City}: Build Cards cause 1 extra Build Action in the highest-numbered matching land. (This can affect a land without Invaders.)
After the Ravage Step, On Each Board: In the land with the most {City} (min. 1), Ravage, then Remove 1 {City}.
When Invaders Ravage, if the land has both {Dahan} and {Presence}, Defend 5.
